scope: AKMM Chapter 3 (pp. 71-92) and Appendix 3.A (pp. 825-826): the Solow model's production assumptions and intensive form, steady state and global convergence, endogenous growth, poverty traps and local stability, the growing economy and balanced growth, factor prices and shares, the speed of convergence, business-cycle variants and impulse responses, and the discrete-time Uzawa theorems.
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 3
